name: Tousatsu Kyoushi to Joshi***sei
source:
Mr. Todou is a pervert voyeur school-teacher.
One day as he was watching his video collection he had an idea.
He decided to target three students...
loving and gentle Chika who dotes on her little sister,
meek and shy little Kurumi,
and the bad girl of class, Fubuki.
This is the story of his approach to them... and their fates... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE094500.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
藤堂老师是一个变态的偷窥狂教师。一天，他在看自己的视频收藏时想到了一个主意。他决定将目标锁定在三个学生身上……疼爱妹妹的温柔千佳、温顺害羞的小胡桃、以及班上的坏女孩吹雪。这是他接近她们的故事……以及她们的命运……
